authorization: Owner authorized further learning and evaluation on 2026-10-03, superseding the one-run limit.
current_only_ablation: Train separately after demonstrating a useful full-memory controller; do not label inference-time masking a trained ablation.
selection: Reject illegal/failed-navigation policies. Compare crew wins, own contribution, voting and behavior with scripted/random/idle. Choose using validation only; do not infer skill from wins carried by other players.
stopping: Inspect checkpoint curves; replicate useful behavior, extend only promising learning, and stop unchanged configurations on a validation plateau. Record failures as well as successes.
budget_note: Longer actions consume more simulated time per policy decision; comparisons must show decisions, simulated seconds and completed matches.
phase6_gate: Only after one learned crewmate works, explore adapting opponents and self-play.
